summary: Extraction pass over 16 stored CBI documents whose ledgers left figures out because they repeat an earlier report or another part of the same report (prior-year comparative columns, monthly columns of earlier years, rounded highlights, scorecard baselines, chart labels restating annex tables). Each figure is recorded under the later document's own source_id as printed, with a note naming the figure it restates or differs from. Also: Saint Kitts and Nevis address rules left over, the Vanuatu CIIP suspension-lift event, and a ledger check for the Grenada copy of the eighth VSM report.

new_indicators.name: Share of applications by status
new_indicators.definition: Percentage of the applications filed in a period that have a stated status at the source date (category=issued, pending, rejected, withdrawn), as printed, e.g. a donut of applications by outcome. Counted by filing period, not decision period. Never calculated by us. Not a grant rate (applications_grant_rate) and not the share decided (applications_decided_share).
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-restated-2026-10-10 (Greek Ministry of Migration legal-migration bulletins 2022-2026, Γράφημα 18/19 donuts, p. 1 donut and the 4γ text share of applications already issued).

new_indicators.name: Change in investor residence permits issued (percent, as printed)
new_indicators.definition: Percentage change in investor residence permits issued between a period and an earlier one, as printed. Never computed from levels. Companion to residence_permits_issued.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-restated-2026-10-10 (Greek legal-migration bulletins 2022-2026, p. 1 infographic arrow on permits issued to main investors).
